messages.subject: For Raj Subramaniam | Global affairs, government relations and international logistics
messages.body:
Dear FedEx Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Raj Subramaniam, President and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

FedEx's global network operates across trade policy, customs, infrastructure, regulatory systems and public-sector relationships. That intersection closely matches the external leadership work I manage today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior engagement across multiple public agencies and complex operating teams.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, cross-border stakeholder management and executive coordination could support FedEx's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to FedEx.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
